title: Shorter startup for free plans
summary: Start Agent now sends a much shorter first message, so free plans on Claude, ClickUp and ChatGPT no longer run out or refuse it. The AI looks up the rest only when it needs it.
added: A Full startup switch in the PlazCode menu (Automation). It is off by default; turn it on only if you want every instruction sent at once on a big paid model.
improved: The startup message is about 6,000 characters instead of about 44,000, on every AI site.
The command list at startup shows command names only; the AI fetches a command's details the first time it uses it.
Your notes summary at startup is shorter.
On DeepSeek, PlazCode waits at least 5 seconds between the messages it sends by itself, and tells you once that DeepSeek may suspend accounts that use automated tools.
fixed: Claude and ClickUp free plans no longer use up their limit on the startup alone.
ChatGPT's free plan no longer refuses the startup as too long.
The Plan and License cards are gone from the app: PlazCode is free and has no key system.
notes: Switched-on modes (Plan mode, thinking level, your custom prompt and the rest) still go into the startup.
The Plan and License change is in the desktop app, so it arrives with the app update.
The Windows app is unsigned and the Mac app is not notarized, as before. Your computer may ask you to confirm opening it.
